notes.title: Major Content Update: New World, Cards, Enemies, Runes, and More...
notes.content:
Greetings, HOEQ community!

After much hard work, we are thrilled to present version 1.2 of our game. This update brings a new world, numerous community suggestions realized, and fresh content for you to enjoy. Thank you for all the support!

[h2]New Post-Game Mode: Visions of Ascension[/h2]

We’re introducing an additional mode, unlockable after completing the main story “Tower of Shards,” which adds a completely new world: Cyber Nexus. Immerse yourself in this futuristic area, filled with advanced technology and mechanical enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/4064c60784f4d8f5af2d5d49f8a500e9829db5ca.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/7f048f77e12c2111c53995ed74bdf5998270659a.png[/img]

Explore the [b]Cyber Nexus[/b] and face:

[list]
[*] 10 new enemies with challenging mechanics and an expanded bestiary. 
[*] A new imposing boss with unique abilities. 
[*] Special events that will transform the experience on the new map. 
[*] New resource: Energy Core. This resource can be collected in the Cyber Nexus to unlock new upgrades. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/9951a0a89adc193ae48376786df4c0bd882313be.png[/img]

[h2]New Citadel Upgrades and Building Cards[/h2]

You can use the new resource obtained to unlock new upgrades and building cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/180b57a5487b355658100d4577f9cae540c7c117.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/c993f15511d294eb73cf0d29027b82d6becce9bb.png[/img]

[h2]New Runes[/h2]
With mechanics focused on the use of Golems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/c8fab88c66d0010acc390e53edbb9ed521061bc6.png[/img]

[h2]New Skills and Their Upgrades[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/b6b8578f31cc3d0d603eee0279c81dba1dc51299.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Damage-dealing structures, such as the Watchtower and Rat Tower, now display their damage stats.
[*] Expedition save system: You can now resume the game by saving from the first round of an expedition. 
[/list]

We hope you enjoy all the new content. We will continue working on future updates to provide the best possible experience. Thank you for joining us in this exciting stage of the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.content: A minor patch aimed at correcting some translation errors.

notes.title: First Major Content Update: Rune Systems, Bestiary, Skills, and More...
notes.content:
Greetings, HOEQ community!

We are excited to announce version 1.1 of our game, a major update that integrates valuable player suggestions and new content. Thank you for your support!

[h2]Rune System[/h2]

We introduce equippable runes that offer passive features and add strategic depth, customization, and further progression to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/0f532731d5d067edca8b2774deedc59320b800d8.png[/img]

We have added [b]42 distinct runes[/b] available to enhance the heroes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/aa6d060189c2adb3026b66f3f858fa7b8d140001.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Crafting System[/h2]

Following your recommendations, we have revamped the crafting system to be more strategic. Items are now permanent, and we have balanced all objects to ensure fair competitiveness in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/b4afeec2b39950a7905a2c91acd2b37d9e0dae80.png[/img]

[h2]Bestiary[/h2]

A compendium of enemies with information about their strengths, weaknesses, abilities, and the resources they offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/9299ca4afc468885100bc8abf331a3642a930dea.png[/img]

[h2]New Skills [/h2]

[b]11[/b] new skills and [b]11[/b] new upgrades available in the runes and for the heroes Alberic and Lionir.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/233f6228029bde50e10d90f7b590642ca2b49a3a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/f251a57091db940d52018d75c2976cd5dd84fb9c.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements and New Features[/h2]

- It is now possible to keep all resources upon completing an expedition.
- Display of progress towards the next skill reward.
- Detail of the characteristics of each summon.
- Option to reshuffle skill rewards for mana.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/903e27e7e9ce3cfaf8c3de90f1739b4969226d35.png[/img]

- Separation of defense types in the interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/55ab296c553539d0608efe42ea55664799550c2d.png[/img]

- Aggregation of consumables in a single space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276538/71e0beed3873a7472f216ded37fefdc49e196ba7.png[/img]

- Improved hero selection with new navigation arrows.
- Enabled zoom for a better view of the citadel improvements.
- Incorporation of avatars for enemies.

[b]Adjustments and Balancing:[/b]

- Adjustments to hero abilities and items to fit the new rune system.
- Changes in specific abilities for heroes and certain constructions.
- Changes in the stats of enemies and bosses.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

- Fixing issues in certain upgrades that caused unwanted effects.
- Adjustments in descriptions and incorrectly reported damages in some forges.
- Corrections of text errors and sporadic technical issues.
- Removal of obsolete items from the crafting system.

We hope you enjoy the new content. We will continue working on a new update to offer the best gaming experience possible. Thank you for being part of HOEQ and for joining us in this new stage of the game!

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.16c
notes.content:
Thank you very much to everyone for the bug reports and suggestions!

- We have fixed a bug with the floor 4 boss. There were occasions when it would not trigger the victory screen.
- We have corrected some minor translations in English and Spanish languages.

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.16a
notes.content:
- We have fixed a rare bug that only occurred with the hero Alberic when facing the Boss on floor 4, which altered the duration of the Boss's main ability, preventing the completion of the floor with this hero.

We will continue working to review all comments and reports from players. Thank you very much.
